results.query: SELECT count(*) AS total, countif(r.status_code = 503) AS http_503, countif(r.status_code = 409) AS http_409 FROM edge_logs CROSS JOIN unnest(metadata) m CROSS JOIN unnest(m.response) r

SELECT count(*) AS total, countif(regexp_contains(event_message, 'CLIENT_UPDATE_REQUIRED')) AS client_update_required, countif(regexp_contains(event_message, 'CLIENT_CONTRACT_CONFIGURATION_ERROR')) AS configuration_error FROM postgres_logs
